modes.title: Shape Clues
modes.skill: identify 2D shapes from sides, corners, and curves

modes.title: Secret Spots
modes.skill: understand spatial language while searching a scene

modes.title: Chalk Map
modes.skill: place one shape using a spoken spatial relation

voice.welcome: Detective, we have shape mysteries to solve. Choose a case.
voice.intro-properties: Shape Clues! Listen for sides, corners, and curves.
voice.intro-search: Secret Spots! Move the magnifying glass and listen for where to look.
voice.intro-place: Chalk Map! Put each shape exactly where the clue says.
voice.retry-property: Look at the sides and corners. Try another shape.
voice.retry-search: Good searching. Listen to the place word and look again.
voice.retry-place: Almost. Listen for the place word and try again.
voice.idle-property: Use your detective eyes. Count the sides and corners.
voice.idle-search: Slide the magnifying glass across the chalk scene.
voice.idle-place: Move the loose shape where the clue says.
voice.complete-properties: Case closed! You solved every shape clue.
voice.complete-search: Case closed! You found every secret spot.
voice.complete-place: Case closed! You made a perfect chalk map.
voice.finale: Master Shape Detective! You used shape clues and spatial words to solve every case.
voice.property-1-prompt: Find the shape that is round all the way, with no corners.
voice.property-1-success: A circle! It is round all the way and has no corners.
voice.property-2-prompt: Find the shape with three straight sides and three corners.
voice.property-2-success: A triangle! Three sides and three corners.
voice.property-3-prompt: Find the shape with four sides. Two are long and two are short.
voice.property-3-success: A rectangle! Two long sides and two short sides.
voice.property-4-prompt: Find the shape with four equal sides, even when it turns.
voice.property-4-success: A square! Four equal sides, even when it turns.
voice.property-5-prompt: Find the shape with six straight sides and six corners.
voice.property-5-success: A hexagon! Six sides and six corners.
voice.search-1-prompt: Find the turquoise circle inside the window.
voice.search-1-success: Inside! The turquoise circle is inside the window.
voice.search-2-prompt: Find the yellow triangle above the house.
voice.search-2-success: Above! The yellow triangle is above the house.
voice.search-3-prompt: Find the coral square between the flowers.
voice.search-3-success: Between! The coral square is between the flowers.
voice.search-4-prompt: Find the sky-blue rectangle below the rainbow.
voice.search-4-success: Below! The sky-blue rectangle is below the rainbow.
voice.search-5-prompt: Find the green hexagon beside the telescope.
voice.search-5-success: Beside! The green hexagon is beside the telescope.
voice.place-1-prompt: Put the yellow triangle above the coral square.
voice.place-1-success: Above! The triangle is above the square.
voice.place-2-prompt: Put the turquoise circle below the yellow triangle.
voice.place-2-success: Below! The circle is below the triangle.
voice.place-3-prompt: Put the sky-blue rectangle beside the turquoise circle.
voice.place-3-success: Beside! The rectangle is beside the circle.
voice.place-4-prompt: Put the coral square between the two pink stars.
voice.place-4-success: Between! The square is between the stars.
voice.place-5-prompt: Put the turquoise circle inside the green hexagon.
voice.place-5-success: Inside! The circle is inside the hexagon.
